title: Update History
intro: What changed in previous versions of the app.

items: Fixed a freeze with no loading indicator when opening the character sheet, bestiary, or spellbook.
Added a loading indicator when switching to these screens, so transitions feel smoother.
Improved crash diagnostics for faster fixes in upcoming releases.
Fixed a permission error when creating a character.
Improved account deletion and error handling.
Fixed ability score limits (point buy / standard array).
Fixed joining a campaign via invite code.
First closed testing release on Google Play.
Create and edit a character offline, no sign-in required.
Google sign-in and cloud sync for character sheets.
Collaborative character sheet editing with other players and the GM.
